intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A prince has brought a traveling display of ceremonial cloaks. He is explaining, loudly, why a cape counts as an emergency public service.

intro.speaker: PRINCE
intro.text: “Every garment makes a statement. Mine says *behold my significance*.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Mine says *someone forgot to account for door handles*.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I once turned around too quickly at a banquet. The curtains came down.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Three ministers took it as a declaration of war. One of them surrendered.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The prince looks thrilled. Behind him, a guard begins inching toward a pillar.

intro.speaker: PRINCE
intro.text: “Princess Kaedra! Our most formidable guest! Will you model the silver mantle? And look *terrifying* in it?”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Is that a requirement of the mantle, or of me?”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Several spectators wait for her to explode. She does not. A tailor drops a pin, and three of them flinch.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I was invited to assess whether the fasteners are safe. They are not.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “The mantle weighs about as much as a small door. All of it hangs from the collar.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “And he wants you to model it anyway?”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “He believes my face could frighten the stitching into cooperation.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She glances at you. The prince is already miming where the dramatic lighting would go.

options.labelText: “You’re here to inspect it, not haunt it. Want help making sure they hear about the collar?”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “You heard the part about the collar.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “And the curtains. But that’s a separate safety issue.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Correct. We must not confuse the two departments.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Kaedra explains the clasp in four calm sentences. The tailor has it fixed before the prince finishes posing.

branch.speaker: PRINCE
branch.text: “Reinforced collars! The latest thing at court! I have always said so!”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “It was easier with someone holding the door.”

options.labelText: “Oh, wear it. Do your legendary terrifying pose. It’d be hilarious.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I do. I like to be in on them.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She takes the loose clasp to the tailor herself. The prince photographs the mantle on its stand, looking formidable without her.

options.labelText: “Just threaten him. Scaring people is what you’re good at.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “No. I am good at making sure nobody has to be scared.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She turns back to the tailor. By the pillar, the guard stays exactly where he is.
